evidence.title: Caprock README
evidence.finding: Local desktop and daemon browser UI, agent tabs, existing subscriptions, phone pairing and CSV/JSONL exports.

evidence.title: Security and data policy
evidence.finding: Local cleartext session SQLite; selected integrations send data only when enabled. Worker permissions are bypassed, worktree is not a sandbox.

evidence.title: Premium pricing
evidence.finding: Free core; Premium $30 yearly or $100 once. Eight paid features include budget pause, Telegram replies, custom agents and additional accounts.

evidence.title: Caprock for Teams
evidence.finding: Customer-hosted aggregate usage service from $500/month billed yearly, not per person; prompts/code have no fields in its described uploaded schema.

evidence.title: Task records
evidence.finding: Markdown task IDs, body, assignee, budget and done criteria; state transition graph and append-only event calls.

evidence.title: Task board
evidence.finding: Create validates title and nonempty criteria, assigns unique ID and default $5 budget; mirrors task state to SQLite.

evidence.title: Verification runner
evidence.finding: Per-command five-minute cap; missing criteria/worktree escalates, failures bounce up to three rounds, outputs persist before Done.

evidence.title: Verifier command screening
evidence.finding: Destructive command regexes apply to done_criteria, not all agent commands.

evidence.title: Orchestrator and worker router
evidence.finding: Claude coordinator and worker processes, mailbox delivery, worker worktrees, bounded wakeups, budget kill and stop-all latch.

evidence.title: Worktree ownership
evidence.finding: Reuse owned path, refuse other checkout or preexisting branch; never force-reset it.

evidence.title: Worktree setup
evidence.finding: Copies configured ignored files and wraps initial agent command in setup; fresh worktree setup differs from reuse.

evidence.title: MCP tool definitions
evidence.finding: Read-only memories, prose, costs, sessions and CI tools; candidate search then full memory read.

evidence.title: Message queue
evidence.finding: 20 messages, 16 KiB each, only owned sessions; permission/question waits prevent unsafe prompt typing.

evidence.title: Permission endpoint
evidence.finding: Allow/always/deny/dismiss choice tied to prompt ID; delegates to live prompt validation.

evidence.title: Paired device controller
evidence.finding: Controller forbids arbitrary commands/flags, limits paths to resolved home, rechecks role for each input frame.

evidence.title: Changes API
evidence.finding: Status/diff/stage/discard/commit/push/pull interface; device mutations constrained to project/worktree scope.

evidence.title: PR pipeline
evidence.finding: PR stages, checks by exact head SHA, releases and linked session cost; display is not merge authorization.

evidence.title: PTY lifecycle contract
evidence.finding: Detached process can live in separate PTY host; pause is POSIX signal or Windows input hold, not identical execution suspension.

evidence.title: Loop detector
evidence.finding: Repeated tool signatures counted per main/subagent lane; default five calls in three minutes emits an alert.

evidence.title: Offline entitlement
evidence.finding: Expiry parsed locally with seven-day grace; no network validation.

evidence.title: Pricing constants
evidence.finding: USD30/year, USD100 lifetime and retained USD5 monthly code path; website currently promotes annual/lifetime.

evidence.title: Desktop dependencies
evidence.finding: Rust Tauri2 desktop wrapper around daemon dashboard.

evidence.title: Current release
evidence.finding: 0.196.0 dated 2026-11-25; performance and UI fixes.

evidence.title: Caprock: cli-core
evidence.finding: CLI starts and stops daemon, installs service/hooks, lists and creates board tasks over loopback API. It is not an SDK or a promise of stable automation for every UI operation.

evidence.title: Caprock: api-routes
evidence.locator: route registrations; task, agents, files, brain, GitHub, export
evidence.finding: Public daemon routes distinguish board task create/get/approve/reject/verify from agent session controls, memory edits, file reads and GitHub operations; no task hierarchy, spec approval, artifact gallery or merge/deploy authority endpoint.

evidence.title: Caprock: launch
evidence.finding: Installed harness commands receive selected model, effort and native permission/resume flags; Codex/OpenCode fork is refused; OpenCode has provider/model syntax. This is local CLI integration, not a replacement model service.

evidence.title: Caprock: ios
evidence.finding: iOS bundles ui/dist-remote React screens in Capacitor, with native storage/biometric/scanner plugins; not a separate native agent runtime.

evidence.title: Caprock for iPhone

evidence.title: Caprock: platform-build
evidence.finding: Desktop packages Tauri web UI for macOS, Windows and Linux; macOS minimum 13.0.

evidence.title: Caprock: task-ui
evidence.locator: GROUPS, TaskDrawer, Checks, WhereItIs, NewTask, StartOrchestrator
evidence.finding: Board distinguishes waiting/working/checking/needs-you/done/failed, creates briefs with commands and budget, optional templates, explicit runner activation. evidence.title: Caprock: mailbox

evidence.title: Caprock: workboard
evidence.finding: Read-only aggregate view combines existing local task/session/queue/cost/PR state, not an epic or dependency scheduler.

evidence.title: Caprock: queueboard
evidence.finding: Work queue shows owned live/recent sessions and estimates from project history; message queue is distinct from CPU/RAM admission.

evidence.title: Caprock: instructions

evidence.title: Caprock: brain

evidence.title: Caprock: brain-search
evidence.finding: Search ranks stored memory text using normalized keywords/IDF and typo fallback; not whole-repository semantic indexing.

evidence.title: Caprock: brain-edit

evidence.title: Caprock: brain-scrub
evidence.finding: Redacts stored memory and source excerpts transactionally; does not retroactively remove secrets from raw session transcripts.

evidence.title: Caprock: obsidian
evidence.finding: Explicit local Markdown vault import rescans changed files and unlinks deleted notes; bounded at 50000 notes and 4MiB per note.

evidence.title: Caprock: mcp-register
evidence.finding: Explicitly registers local caprock MCP server in Claude/Codex configurations through their CLIs; not a generic Caprock MCP client.

evidence.title: Caprock: files
evidence.finding: Project/worktree file listing and capped reads reject symlink/path escapes; current filesystem contents, no immutable artifact snapshots.

evidence.title: Caprock: paste
evidence.finding: Allowed image/PDF/text/office/source uploads up to 10MiB persist as local files with restricted names/modes for agent input; no general task artifact registry.

evidence.title: Caprock: capture
evidence.finding: Feedback capture produces a real own-window image on macOS/Windows; Linux capture button unsupported. Not automatic screenshots of tested products or video capture.

evidence.title: Caprock: devshare
evidence.finding: Explicit temporary proxy shares only loopback dev servers via private LAN/Tailscale access, opaque link/cookie, at most three shares, 30-minute idle/8-hour max, no restart persistence.

evidence.title: Caprock: review-notes
evidence.finding: Per-worktree line/range notes retain code quote and timestamp in browser localStorage until sent/cleared; no user identity or exact commit hash, and no shared review ledger.

evidence.title: Caprock: changes-ui
evidence.locator: sendNotes, key handlers, file/diff and conflict controls
evidence.finding: Diff review supports line notes sent as one agent prompt, staging and keyboard navigation; notes are cleared after handoff. This is request-changes assistance, not revision-bound approval.

evidence.title: Caprock: pulls
evidence.finding: Creates GitHub PR after optional push; validates branch/base/remote and handles existing PR. Reads reviews/check status. No native approve/merge mutation in scoped routes.

evidence.title: Caprock: ci
evidence.locator: CI, CIRun.HeadSHA, jobs/log reads, refresh intervals
evidence.finding: Reads CI runs/jobs/steps for commit SHA, retains bounded log tails and timestamps; list-rate runner estimates differ from invoices.

evidence.title: Caprock: release-ci
evidence.finding: Reads tag/release workflow status and release links using bounded recent-run search; does not authorize releases or deployments.

evidence.title: Caprock: ci-retry
evidence.finding: Opt-in rerun only when all failed jobs got no runner; eligible recent runs are recorded before API call, capped history 256 entries; ordinary failed tests are not automatically retried by this policy.

evidence.title: Caprock: git-project
evidence.finding: Scoped Git mutations use per-checkout locks, refusal checks and stale discard token; pull is fast-forward only. Divergence/conflicts require terminal/agent repair, not automatic rebase.

evidence.title: Caprock: github-intake
evidence.finding: User-triggered open GitHub issue/PR picker with body/URL seeds context; not background bidirectional issue synchronization.

evidence.title: Caprock: host-registry
evidence.finding: Separate PTY holders persist private atomic connection records and child-exit records for daemon reattachment.

evidence.title: Caprock: host-client
evidence.finding: Reattaches live holders, replays bounded output since offset, retries connection with bounded attempts, uses sequenced writes/acks; unreachable holder is lost process, not revived execution.

evidence.title: Caprock: host-server
evidence.finding: Holder deduplicates sequenced client writes in memory; no exactly-once guarantee for arbitrary agent tool effects or after holder death.

evidence.title: Caprock: resume
evidence.finding: Ended sessions require supported native resume ID and extant transcript/directory; live owned sessions reused. Stored display history does not guarantee native resumability.

evidence.title: Caprock: interrupted
evidence.finding: Durable heartbeat distinguishes interrupted local work after restart; does not automatically restore a dead operating-system process.

evidence.title: Caprock: continue
evidence.finding: Supported Claude account/provider continuation can copy/fork native transcript; cross-harness transfer is a separate brief flow.

evidence.title: Caprock: handoff
evidence.finding: Editable cross-harness brief takes latest assistant passage, changed files and known PR links, capped at 8000 characters; not full native context or permissions transfer.

evidence.title: Caprock: reconnect-ui
evidence.finding: Browser socket retries with jitter up to 15 seconds, wake probes and explicit disconnected/revoked states; implemented recovery policy, not observed success.

evidence.title: Caprock: supervisor
evidence.finding: Desktop reuses one compatible daemon per data directory; quitting viewer leaves daemon/agent sessions. Host must remain running.

evidence.title: Caprock: queued-store
evidence.finding: Undelivered queued messages persist in SQLite separately from live process state.

evidence.title: Caprock: queue-resend
evidence.finding: Explicit resend finds live/resumable session in same agent/folder or creates fresh session; does not silently replay all previous tool actions.

evidence.title: Caprock: resources
evidence.finding: Measures local owned process CPU/RAM on demand for UI and orphan cleanup; no CPU/RAM reservation or resource admission queue.

evidence.title: Caprock: daily-cap
evidence.finding: Optional Premium daily API-equivalent budget pauses owned sessions only; external sessions untouched, estimates not provider billing controls.

evidence.title: Caprock: window-cap
evidence.locator: window sample freshness, pause latch, reset resume
evidence.finding: Premium Claude window pause uses fresh plan samples and persisted state; respects manual resume and resumes after reset.

evidence.title: Caprock: planshare
evidence.finding: Allocates user-entered subscription fee over recorded list-price usage; incomplete usage and provider allowance remain distinct from invoices.

evidence.title: Caprock: cost-refresh
evidence.finding: Subscription spend projection caches a minute; not real-time billed reconciliation.

evidence.title: Caprock: export
evidence.finding: Offline read-only SQLite export of events/sessions as TSV/CSV/JSONL, optional raw JSONL payload; not a full task/runtime migration bundle.

evidence.title: Caprock: pairing
evidence.locator: roles, single-use code, device token lifecycle
evidence.finding: Paired device viewer/controller permissions, expiring one-use pairing code and revocable device token; not organization member roles.

evidence.title: Caprock: csrf
evidence.finding: Loopback local-owner API enforces browser CSRF/origin and DNS-rebinding guards; not SSO authenticated organization access.

evidence.title: Caprock: lan-auth
evidence.finding: Paired requests require token and role-scoped routes; controller input and Git paths constrained. Local owner access is broader than device access.

evidence.title: Caprock: noise
evidence.finding: Phone transport uses pinned daemon identity and end-to-end Noise encryption; does not provision cloud execution.

evidence.title: Caprock: remote-keys
evidence.finding: Private daemon identity and optional persistent remote enablement stored locally, configurable relay URL.

evidence.title: Caprock: relay-selfhost
evidence.finding: Own Go relay implementation routes paired encrypted sockets, caps devices and expires silent hosts; not agent compute.

evidence.title: Caprock: cursor-launch

evidence.title: Caprock independent inspection: review-queue
evidence.finding: Turn/prompt waiting is Claude-hook-specific; non-Claude kinds return no waiting state. SendNow and automatic delivery delete the queue row before typing, so a typing failure is not lossless. Ended-session queues and explicit resend are separate recovery paths.

evidence.title: Caprock independent inspection: review-idle
evidence.finding: Default configured idle window is 12h; excludes open tabs, orchestrator workers, shells, paused/queued/pending-prompt or continuing background/subagent work. This ends eligible local processes, not a cloud sandbox TTL.

evidence.title: Caprock independent inspection: review-windows-pause
evidence.finding: Windows pause holds input without suspending the process. POSIX pause semantics cannot be attributed to Windows; task worker kill is a separate control.

evidence.title: Caprock independent inspection: review-log-platform
evidence.finding: logcap is supported on unix; non-unix path sets supported=false. Windows service logging is separate.
